text: The accepted Storybook story imports the actual notification element and icon stylesheet, supplies the templates expected by that element, selects in-app-notification and passes the scenario through setNotificationData. Its setData option can leave the fixture without a payload. Use the real component, required templates and production setter in nearby stories so the scenario exercises the same input contract. Existing knowledge already covers pre-connection storage and replay. This is a scoped manual recommendation from static source. No Storybook, runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Use the real notification element and payload setter in Storybook
